methodology: To systematically decompose the provided information into atomic units, I analyzed each statement to identify distinct requirements, features, and behaviors. Each unit was defined to be independent, specific, and implementable.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Design a decade counter module in Verilog.
The counter counts sequentially from 1 to 10 inclusively.
The counter resets to 1 when the active-high synchronous reset signal is asserted.
The module has an input clock signal 'clk'.
The module has an input reset signal 'reset'.
The module has a 4-bit output register 'q' representing the current count.
spec_atomic_units: The module has an input clock signal 'clk'.
The module has an input active-high synchronous reset signal 'reset'.
The module has a 4-bit output register 'q' representing the current count.
The counter increments its value on the rising edge of the clock signal.
When the reset signal is asserted, the counter resets to 1 on the next rising edge of the clock.
The counter cycles through values 1 to 10 inclusively, resetting to 1 after reaching 10.
The combinational logic determines the next value of the counter based on the current value of 'q' and the state of the 'reset' signal.
The design minimizes propagation delay and ensures efficient operation.
The output 'q' is updated synchronously with the clock signal.
